candidates.title: 'Ringleader' in Manitoba high school hockey hazing complaint loses suspension appeal
candidates.description: A Manitoba high school hockey player implicated in a series of sexualized hazing acts against rookie teammates has lost an appeal of his lengthy suspension from Hockey Canada activities.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Sask. horse gets 2nd chance at life after being rescued from frozen creek near Cochin
candidates.description: Frosty the horse was rescued from a frozen Lehman Creek, near the resort village of Cochin. He came out alive, but with major injuries. Now, after long months of treatments and recovery, Frosty is thriving on his new farm with his new family.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 10 years later, Colten Boushie's family says stereotypes, mistruths still surround his death
candidates.description: 10 years after Colten Boushie was shot and killed on a rural Saskatchewan farm, his family says there are few opportunities for healing. With every new article and social media post come hateful comments, often presented by people who are ignorant of the facts surrounding his death.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Road to Avonlea fans thrilled to rub shoulders with TV show’s cast and crew in P.E.I.
candidates.description: Fans of hit 1990s TV show Road to Avonlea flocked to Charlottetown this weekend to meet the cast and crew. The three-day convention included oyster and wine tastings and panel discussions.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Turn a racetrack into a school? The idea is causing tensions in a Quebec town
candidates.description: This week, elected officials voted to establish a land reserve on the grounds of Sanair, a 57-year-old racetrack in Saint-Pie, Que. The site is being considered for a new high school.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Emergency alert ended as shooting suspect arrested in Halifax Regional Municipality
candidates.description: RCMP say an emergency alert covering the Halifax Regional Municipality has ended now that the suspect is in custody. The suspect is believed to have been involved in a shooting earlier Saturday in South Farmington, N.S., say RCMP.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. booze might end up back on Canadian shelves, but have we lost the taste for it?
candidates.description: Canada is prepared to lift bans on sales of alcohol from the United States in exchange for U.S. tariff relief, sources told CBC this week. But a recent poll showed nearly 70 per cent of Canadians said they wouldn't buy American booze if it returns to store shelves north of the border.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Organized crime is using encrypted messaging apps to enlist youth. This spells trouble for police
candidates.description: While police have made arrests after gunshots were fired at the U.S. Consulate in downtown Toronto in two separate incidents in recent months, finding those responsible for these alleged gun-for-hire plots remains elusive. Investigators say they are hamstrung without provisions from the federal government's controversial Bill C-22.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Kiashke Zaaging Anishinaabek 'vehemently' opposes Ontario ending wildfire implementation, evacuation orders
candidates.description: The leadership of Kiashke Zaaging Anishinaabek, also known as Gull Bay First Nation, is “vehemently opposing” the Ontario government's withdrawal of wildfire implementation and evacuation orders around the community. The orders were updated at 12:02 a.m. ET.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Few hotels, emergency support services for B.C. fire evacuees, says OKIB member
candidates.description: Approximately 30 Okanagan Indian Band members and around 200 non-band members have lost their homes to wildfire over August long weekend, according to the band's chief. Evacuees say they faced issues and delays receiving financial support from Emergency Support Services, and many continue to struggle to secure hotel rooms in the Interior.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Parents who missed kid's birthday due to WestJet strike say nothing can make up for it
candidates.description: Calgary couple's return journey from San Francisco was so chaotic due to the WestJet strike that they got home three days late — and missed their youngest's second birthday because of it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 2 Sask. restaurant operators convicted of trafficking woman from Bangladesh
candidates.description: Two Saskatchewan men have been found guilty of human trafficking for exploiting a Bangladeshi woman who worked in their restaurants in Gull Lake, Tisdale and Elrose.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Premier says it's up to Quebec — and Quebec alone — when U.S. booze returns to its shelves
candidates.description: Quebec's premier says U.S. products will remain off the shelves of its government-run liquor stores, regardless of reports that Canada is readying to meet some U.S. demands, including rolling back its ban on American alcohol.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Check your credit card bills': Gordie Howe bridge user says he's been double charged for crossings
candidates.description: A man who made several trips across the Gordie Howe International Bridge during opening week says he was double charged for some of those trips and is urging other travelers to check their credit card bills.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trucking company involved in deadly Manitoba crash among 20 carriers 'eliminated' in Alberta
candidates.description: Conquer Transportation, whose truck was in a fatal crash in Brandon, Man., in May — after it had its safety permit pulled in Manitoba — now can't operate from Alberta, the province's transportation minister said Thursday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hamas must disarm for Israel to pull out of Gaza, Netanyahu says
candidates.description: In televised remarks to his right-wing government Sunday, Israeli President Benjamin Netanyahu restated his rejection of Donald Trump's latest Gaza plan, even as Israel's military ‌has effectively halted attacks in the territory under pressure from the U.S. president.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Typhoon Dolphin hits China's east coast, over 1 million evacuated
candidates.description: Typhoon Dolphin, the most powerful tropical cyclone to hit China this year, made landfall on the ‌country's eastern coast on Sunday, bringing torrential rain and strong winds and triggering warnings of flooding and landslides.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump's latest push to reshape U.S. history? Signs at the Smithsonian
candidates.description: The Smithsonian's National Museum of American History is at the centre of an effort by the Trump administration that observers say is part of a broader attempt to reshape the stories of the United States as told by the country's cultural institutions.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia
candidates.description: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked an oil facility Sunday in southwestern Saudi Arabia, in the latest attack by the Iranian-backed rebels on the kingdom.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 14-year-old accused in deadly school shooting in Thailand had watched violent online content, police say
candidates.description: An air gun was confiscated last year from the 14-year-old boy accused in a school shooting outside Bangkok that left several people dead, police said Sunday as the Thai government promised new safety protocols for schools. The mother of the accused speaks on the last time she saw him.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Taiwan's cabinet to propose 16% annual rise in defence spending as Taipei bolsters its military
candidates.description: ‌Taiwan's cabinet will propose a 16 per cent annual rise in defence spending for 2027, which would for the first time exceed $1 trillion in Taiwanese money ($43.3 billion Cdn), the official Central News Agency reported on Sunday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada, U.S. shadow Chinese research ships in the Arctic as concern grows over Snow Dragons' presence
candidates.description: Canada and the U.S. are shadowing two Chinese icebreakers operating in Arctic waters off Alaska, amid growing concern their scientific missions could also gather strategically valuable undersea data. Defence experts warn China’s expanding Arctic presence is testing Canada's already stretched military capabilities.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: On America's northern border, the threats are not unidirectional
candidates.description: While U.S. President Donald Trump has accused Canada of allowing illegal drugs and traffickers across the border, the reality on the ground appears very different. CBC News recently spent two days with U.S. Customs and Border Protection in and around Detroit.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'I woke up and I had lost the baby': Miscarriages in Gaza spike amid harsh conditions, UN report finds
candidates.description: Women in Gaza experienced nearly 4,000 miscarriages between January and June this year, according to a UN report that suggests that rate is more than three times higher than in the second half of 2025. Though it's not yet clear exactly what is behind the spike, a doctor in central Gaza says harsh living conditions as well as fear and anxiety are contributing factors.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 12-year-old girl dies following Thailand shooting, bringing victim death toll to at least 8
candidates.description: Another victim has died following a mass shooting in Thailand, northwest of Bangkok, bringing the death toll to eight, excluding the shooter.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian strikes in Kyiv region kill 4 people, including a 3-year-old
candidates.description: Four people in Kyiv region have been killed by russian strikes overnight. The youngest was a three-year-old who was killed along with grandparents.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Authorities say remains of 56 people found improperly stored at Chicago funeral home
candidates.description: The remains of 56 people were found improperly stored and decomposing Thursday at a Chicago funeral home run by a couple who previously operated a crematory that was similarly shut down because of mishandled remains, authorities said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why is gaming giant Roblox losing tens of billions in market value?
candidates.description: Roblox isn’t getting the high financial scores that it used to, as the popular gaming platform has lost approximately $70 billion US in market value over the last year. The company says the steep drop-off is partly because of changes in the games its users play and growing pains as it attempts to attract older gamers — but experts say more could be at play.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control
candidates.description: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread over more than 39 sq miles (103 sq km).
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ecuador charges ex-minister over presidential candidate assassination case
candidates.description: Prosecutors accuse six others, including the leader of cartel Los Lobos, of having an indirect role in the murder of Fernando Villavicencio.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Drones spotted over German base days after Leipzig bomb incident
candidates.description: Police are investigating a drone sighting over a miltary base reportedly used for housing Patriot missile system parts.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
candidates.description: Both sides suggest progress in talks to agree a new shipping route through the strait, but a breakthrough remains unclear.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: An unbearable rotting stench is plaguing an LA neighbourhood
candidates.description: Heaps of rotting meat have been festering in the summer sun after a fire ripped through a huge food warehouse.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Spain imposes border controls against Italy as row over Ceuta migrant influx intensifies
candidates.description: Italy introduced border controls following an influx of about 78,000 migrants from Morocco into the neighbouring Spanish exclave of Ceuta.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
candidates.description: The storm has cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured five people on the Japanese island.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
candidates.description: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
candidates.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
candidates.description: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
candidates.description: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?
candidates.description: The government is trying to attribute blame for the unprecedented fires which tore through the country last month.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Australia is the planet's extinction hotspot, but one animal offers a glimmer of hope
candidates.description: The country is home to some of the world's most unique species - but it is losing them at an alarming rate.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
candidates.description: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: BBC asks Infantino if he will resign as Fifa president
candidates.description: The head of the football governing body has faced multiple calls to quit after his aborted attempt to sell private stakes in the World Cup.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What we know so far about the deadly Thailand shooting
candidates.description: At least seven people have died after a teenage boy shot his grandparents before opening fire on a school in Bangkok.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Is football AI-proof? Why tech investors wanted a slice of the World Cup
candidates.description: What was the thinking of the investors backing the now-canned plan, and are such proposals in the future inevitable?
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Rare turtle to be sent back home in 5,000-mile 'incredibly emotional' trip
candidates.description: A rare turtle is being flown home to the Caribbean Sea after being found washed up in Wales.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Most of sun to be eclipsed across island of Ireland
candidates.description: Skywatchers are set to witness two major celestial events next week, with a deep partial solar eclipse followed by the peak of the Perseid meteor shower.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Hosepipe bans in force as drought declared - is your area affected?
candidates.description: More than 20 million households have been placed under hosepipe bans due to higher demand and low rainfall.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'If we worry about erosion, we will never get any sleep'
candidates.description: Derick Bowler says even if he won the lottery he knows he would not be able to stop nature.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Waste company owner is a 'woman in a man's world'
candidates.description: A woman who runs a waste collection firm says she was warned not to get involved in the industry.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What it's like to chase solar eclipses around the world
candidates.description: For many, a total solar eclipse is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. But for a dedicated few, it's a deep passion.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What you need to know about the solar eclipse over Yorkshire
candidates.description: Yorkshire residents have a rare chance to see the best view of a solar eclipse since 1999 next week.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: In Munich, it's never too early for a breakfast beer with sausage and pretzels
candidates.description: Bavarians traditionally wash down a breakfast of boiled veal sausage, sweet mustard and a giant pretzel with beer — all before the church bells ring at midday.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: This rising painter reimagines Renaissance art in a cocoa plantation in Cameroon
candidates.description: A new gallery show in London features the paintings of Marc Padeu, playing with themes from Renaissance art and bringing them to his homeland of Cameroon.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia, and other Middle East news
candidates.description: Meanwhile, Iran has made new demands about the restart of negotiations and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and the Pentagon is pressing the U.S. defense industry to accelerate production of weapons.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Meet the man circumnavigating the Arctic Ocean, alone
candidates.description: Matt Rutherford is sailing 10,000 nautical miles, through ice floes and gales, to try and accomplish a world first. He spoke with NPR from the cabin of his boat.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Tanker sailors still face danger in the Strait of Hormuz
candidates.description: An agreement over the Strait of Hormuz is still far away. Tim Wilkins, who works for a tanker industry group, says the ships stuck around the waterway are in limbo, and transiting is still dangerous.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Ukraine mourns 'collector of souls' Oleksiy Yukov, killed recovering war dead
candidates.description: Oleksiy Yukov spent two decades recovering the bodies of soldiers — including many Russians. He was killed during a recovery mission after stepping on a landmine.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: K-pop's global wave inspires Chile's next pop stars
candidates.description: K-pop conquered the world — now Chile's young creatives are remixing the movement and making it their own.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Switzerland is a neutral nation but has more nuclear bunkers than any country in the world
candidates.description: Instead of scrapping its network of bomb shelters after the Cold War, Switzerland kept building them. The country has more than 370,000 nuclear bomb shelters. Some are now used to house migrants.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Regal Cinema CEO comes out in support of Paramount-Warner Bros. merger
candidates.description: CEOs of the country's two biggest theater chains say they support the merger of Paramount-Skydance with Warner Brothers-Discovery.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: How FIFA President Gianni Infantino reached the pinnacle of power in soccer
candidates.description: Gianni Infantino is facing intense heat over a failed plan to privatize the World Cup. He is a lawyer who rose to the pinnacle of soccer and is now trying to hold onto his job.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Selling experiences, not things: Services overtake physical goods in downtown retail
candidates.description: America's downtowns are changing. Storefronts that used to showcase clothes or gifts are giving way to gyms and salons. Last year marked the first time that more retail space went to shops offering services rather than things.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Trump renews push to fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook
candidates.description: Trump is once again threatening to fire Cook over unproven allegations of mortgage fraud after an earlier effort to remove Cook was struck down by the Supreme Court.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: There's a birth control backlash online. Can it explain the rise in abortions?
candidates.description: The number of abortions is up in the United States. Is it because fewer people are using birth control pills?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Federal funds can't be used to give test strips to drug users, raising overdose fears
candidates.description: Drug addiction groups are reeling after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to hand out test strips to drug users. The strips help users check street drugs for dangerous adulterants.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Infections from raw milk have sickened more than 100 in Idaho
candidates.description: Cyclosporiasis has been getting all the headlines, but infections from raw milk have sickened more than 100 in Idaho this summer.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: M 5.6 - 57 km WNW of Skwentna, Alaska
candidates.description: The United States Geological Survey reported an earthquake of magnitude 5.6. The event occurred near 57 km WNW of Skwentna, Alaska. Official monitoring data may be updated as scientists review additional measurements.
